I only recently got into Sims 4, and while I enjoyed my time with that game, I quickly got sick and tired of EA's nickel and diming of content. So I was very excited when InZOI was first revealed. 

Some time later and now the game is here, early access at least, and so far I have been pretty disappointed. The game looks fantastic on the surface: a great character creator, nice graphics, in-depth customization and build options and a seemingly complex social system. Yet, when playing, you quickly realize that underneath all the glitter, there's really nothing there. 

The entire life simulation aspect of this game is borderline non-functional. Sure the people look pretty and live in pretty houses, but they barely do anything. There are no consequences for your actions, interactions lead to nowhere; there's no "progress" to be made in a game sense. It feels incredibly life- and pointless. Then there's the constant promises of groundbreaking features like the AI integration: allowing for dynamic and responsive NPC's, unlimited creativity thanks to on-the-fly asset generation, customized poses and animations, yada, yada, yada. 
What it amounts to is a text to image model making terrible textures, an image to model... model that creates nightmarish structures of molten plastic and a video to animation model that let's you import your weird tiktok dances as janky emotes. No thanks. I'll be waiting for Paralives.

The music is a delight and is extremely reminiscent of the Spyro series. 

This game has a little bit for everyone. There are a good number of unique and engaging biomes to explore, some light collectathon elements between body parts, shrines, and [spoiler] secret facilities [/spoiler]. Some neat boss fights that are certainly souls-inspired, although don't expect soul-crushing difficulty here. And, of course, the triceratops in the room, the creature creation process. You can find and collect various body parts by defeating varied and interesting enemies. Everything from a simple chicken to a [spoiler] mecha robot [/spoiler]. You can of course, mix and match these parts, all of which have unique stats and some of them give you unique methods of attack or special abilities! You can even [spoiler] fuse some of these parts together to increase their stats! [/spoiler]. Spore, eat your heart out! It also has a fun little story concerning where you and the other mutants came from, why the areas you explore are the way they are now, and [spoiler] where all the humans went [/spoiler]. The areas are open, but progression is linear, which I personally prefer and the game most certainly respects your time. 100% is easily achievable in under 15 hours even if you are spending ample time lamenting [spoiler] the high failure chance of fusing a dragon tail with a butterfly tail [/spoiler].

There are some bugs (ha) here and there, but the devs are actively working to correct those and invite players to join their discord server to report said bugs (and are very nice about it to boot, I might add). A phenomenal game made by a team who clearly love what they do all at an exceptional price that is well worth the money. 8.5/10.

It's less of a "haunted game" and more of an Escape Room with a game in it. Or maybe an Escape Corridor: a long, linear string of Escape Room style puzzles. Pretty much everything is a clue or somehow related to progressing: this means no real environmental storytelling, and minimal story and lore. And honestly, that's all right.

The puzzles' difficulty was on the lower side, a little too easy at times - although some I found frustrating. Don't be afraid to use the Hint system: it's a nice one, giving you ideas piecemeal before just straight out telling you what to do. Although this part is best experienced yourself.

The story leaves a lot unsaid - but it says enough to get the gist of it, understand the who, the what and the why. I wish there was more. That's my main problem with pure Escape Room style games - since everything needs to be related to the puzzles, there's not much room for story. That said, I was generally satisfied on that front.

Overall, the game might be a little forgettable; but it manages to keep you curious. What's behind this door? How do I open this chest? Everything is very compact, there's pretty much no padding whatsoever, so you just slide through the entire thing; before you know it, bam, end of the game. But that's a good thing! Keeps you going.

Seems like a lot of people have had a similar experience. There are 3 endings, all of which happen more or less at the same point. The achievement stats for them are 64%, 56% and 40%. Those are excellent numbers (even for a 3 hour game), and they probably tell you all you need to know.

I'm currently what I imagine to be more than halfway through this game. I will update my review when I have fully finished it and give some time to contemplate on it. 

Keep in mind that my perspective of this game is as a leftist queer person with an interest in history. I was curious and eager to see how this game would handle the topic of processing traumas and unlearning harmful coping mechanisms and thoughts for immortal beings, especially since I have gone through (and am still following) my own mental health journey. 

Overall this game is quite interesting and the main fun I get from it is from the main draw of the game: helping other vampires in trying to let go of the things that they cannot control or change from their lives, and helping them discover ways to cope and embrace with their present and long futures for the better. I feel that if this game's very niche premise appeals to you, you should give it an honest shot. I like how much the vampire's past influences who they are today and how much the game does use real-life historical moments and history in contextualizing where the characters are at. I also like how this game has given some things of my own to contemplate and unpack.

However this game has a big problem in treating certain political or ideological stances as inherently more "enlightened" or more sensible than others as it is brought up more than just once or twice. For the sake of absolute clarity, this game absolutely does NOT shy away from criticism towards Americans, aspects of American culture, USAmerican politics, capitalism, heternormativity, and monosexuality (especially as the protagonist comes from 1880's America). I do not have any issue with these criticisms, but I absolutely do have issues with [i] how [/i] this game engages with these criticisms. They often feel like further virtue-signalling to the intended audience of the game rather than any sort of meaningful worldbuilding or commentary and often aren't that funny. It would most likely alienate most people interested in this game in one way or another. Additionally, despite this game clearly tries to give a lot of consideration for mental health and how therapy is used, it gets some very crucial clauses of being a therapist very wrong.

Additionally, I find that the blood-sucking minigame needs a little bit of work. Often the "fangs" are falling on both safe AND unsafe places to drink most of the time and I usually find myself just clicking until my meal is happy.

Due to my criticisms I wouldn't really recommend this game to people that take leftist politics or LGBTQ+ activism seriously, and I would hesitate to recommend this game to someone who is beginning to foster an interest in therapy and psychiatry out of concern that this game doesn't depict accurately how a therapist should behave or interact with their clients (outside of the obvious fictional and larger-than-life aspects). That said, I would recommend this game to people who are liberal looking for something introspective (as this game tends to use their language) and people that would be interested in the main point/gameplay and are willing to have a good time with it despite its faults.

Vampire Therapist often falls into the trap of "framing left-wing politics as inherently more intellectual and superior", shown most prominently by depicting Andromachos, the wise and handsome mentor character, as staunchly left-leaning (or anti-right wing). I feel as if the writers/developers of this game felt very good and powerful using the masculine, rational, and exceedingly powerful and handsome character share their values and often use him as a sockpuppet or platform for their own current frustrations of current-day politics. It's not the criticisms themselves that I have a problem with, but rather the way that these criticisms deviate from what his character is- or should- be. I forgive the writers/devs for not being the most educated in this topic or not having the time to read dense theory and literature about economics and politics, but I think Andromachos should be a little bit above making snide and oftentimes downright trite comments about key players and contributors to current American politics without having some sort of historical reference to contrast and make a point about WHY he thinks the people he dislikes are bad. It makes sense for other characters to be a bit more frank or not as well-worded since most characters I've met thus far AT MOST have been half of age, and Andromachos obviously should have a sense of humor, but it really comes across as oddly childish and worn-out coming from him. I find this tendency to frame leftist attitudes as inherently 'better' than others and ridiculing capitalism or conservativism is one of the biggest obstacles we face. It comes across as extremely presumptuous and pretentious.

Additionally, I have a big bone to pick with the dialogue between Sam and Andromachos regarding Sam's first attraction to a man. Even as a bisexual guy that has been a part of, and is familiar with others' open relationships, I strongly dislike and resent the notion that monosexuality or romantic exclusivity is something that one simply "grows out" of given a certain amount of time and boredom. Even if you were to believe that "everyone is a little bit gay" or has the capacity to harbor attraction to someone atypical to a person's typical gender or sex preference OR harbor attraction to more than one person at a time, it is wrong to assume or intuit that everyone would be interested or want to engage with that. This game invalidates Sam's attraction to another man and minimizes his experience of figuring out that he wasnt "just straight" on the assumption that all vampires will just end up pan/bisexual eventually, so this sort of thing isn't really interesting or new. 

I was just disappointed that this game decided to use bi/pansexual defaultism rather than entertain the notion that maybe most vampires may *experiment* after awhile and are more sexually and romantically open-minded as a result. To me, ignoring the realistic and often more complex relationships with gender, sex, and romance and choosing to "make things easier" by essentially saying "all vampires are bi/pan across the board, no further questions" is lazy at best and can come across very invalidating to gays and lesbians that would be interested in this game.

Due to these two criticisms, I oftem find myself bracing myself for Sam's therapy sessions rather than looking forward to them. While I would be interested in learning more about Sam's life and seeing him grow, I often find the positives of his therapy sessions are often undermined by jabs about American politics and American christian culture rather than thoughtful and nuanced deconstructions of them.

Regarding the actual role of therapy and how it's depicted in this game, I'm also willing to make some exceptions for some faux pas this game makes, especially since this game has some similarities to Ace Attorney games which are notoriously known for focusing on entertainment rather than accuracy (I say with love). However, it feels like such a massive flaw to have Sam blabbing about his clients IMMEDIATELY after his sessions with them. I understand that it is useful to have another character Sam can talk to to reflect his findings and what he has learned, but could it not have been the literal partner of his mentor? I also think it would have not have been that much work to have rewritten Sam's dialogues with Crimson where they discuss the same things without divulging his client's personal information. It makes it hard to really feel like what we are doing in the game is meaningful when the game crosses one of the most important boundaries imperative to a good therapist's ethics. 
[/spoilers]

Absolutely adored this and feel like a judgemental hag for having the low expectations of it that I did. Frankly I expected something far more shallow and dating simulatory (again, judgemental, and this game has me calling myself on it!) but there was real depth to the writing, and an obvious commitment to accurately representing these ideas. I am genuinely impressed at how these developers have managed to gameify such a nebulous thing as self-betterment without it ever feeling reductive. It doesn't resort to "number go up" reinforcement. Success was satisfying even without there really being a way to fail. And though I've had plenty of therapy myself and learnt about cognitive distortions before, I think these varied examples of the tricks humans have played on themselves for millennia is going to help me remember them a lot better than my previous conception ("assorted things I do because I suck," essentially).

For many of us, our only interactions with cognitive behavioural therapy (or any therapy) are going to be tied to an institution/funding body which is solely interested in getting us back into work/making us more economically productive.  Without wanting to go overboard here, it is so meaningful to me to find media like this, which can teach people about these tools in an enjoyable way, completely removed from that shame and pressure-filled environment. As much as we CAN ever remove ourselves from shame and pressure.

The anti-nationalist angle was particularly refreshing to me. They didn't have to include that but they did, and I'm so appreciative of it at this moment in history. Oh to be a vampire without a nationality.

Also great music and art and characterisation. More positives than I can qualify. Thank you guys. Going to be thinking about this for a while.

Wee Tanks is, by all accounts, a unique kind of gem as far as indies goes where many kinds of niche and experimental genres are explored in a gaming industry that is increasingly focused purely on "what works" from a financial perspective, basically what sells to the largest demographics out there. Thankfully we have this very indie to thank for bringing a bit of that former glory back in new modern fashion whilst paying respects to the older ways of how games were designed back then!

Though to give a brief bit of history for this fun title, Wee Tanks is inspired by the lesser-known brother of one of Nintendo's most iconic games ever, that being Wii Play being in the shadow of Wii Sports back in 2006 during the console's release. Seeing as it offered nine distinct minigames that each played around with different gimmicks to appeal to the casual crowd during a time when the Wii remote's motion-based controls was quite the novel idea, although five of them featured the prominent 'Mii' characters whilst three others were more or less fun but unremarkable in the long-run. (Those being a neon-themed hockey minigame, a standard billiards experience and kiddie's first taste of arcade fishing)

The last one was most certainly a standout experience however, as the final minigame featured these lovely toy tanks set in a wooden arena where the goal was simply to destroy the enemy tanks that grew in numbers, complexity and ferocity as the levels became much more strategic and intense in action the further you progressed. This was clearly something that the developers themselves enjoyed working on as not only did it host an initial 20 levels for the gold medal but then unlocked the remaining 80 levels that, past round 30 for the platinum, was purely for the fun and thrill of the action!

Given all of the untapped potential that remained with such a fun premise that was stuck on Wii Play until recently, it's why I am glad that Studio Kit has taken the brave move to build upon the idea that Nintendo created and improve it in so many ways, boldly recreating the visuals and artstyle to near-perfection! Simply said, the graphics are splendid as far as what that tanks minigame would look like today in modern times and it goes without saying that Wee Tanks already hits the nail bang on as far as the visuals go!

But what of the gameplay itself? To rest any concerns, the tight tank controls and the precise ricochet-style of bullet shooting remains top-notch here as I reckon it was a top priority of the developers behind this indie to replicate that experience as close to Wii Play's most renowned minigame as possible, to which they certainly have achieved that and more! Seeing as the campaign stays true to the 100 level formula alongside the many different tanks that featured in the original alongside quite a few new ones too!

To give some examples, the basic brown is stuck and hardly ever fires at all whilst the simple grey tanks aren't much more of a threat with basic accuracy and bullets. From there it slowly evolves as teal tanks introduce fast-firing missiles (these thankfully do not ricochet!) and yellow ones plant mines to catch unaware players off-guard, then the notorious red and purple tank combos that are known for being aggressive and prioritizing ricochet shots where possible respectively followed by the dreaded greens that are deadly versions of browns with their double-ricochet missiles with precise accuracy and, of course, the stealthy white tanks that acted as the 'final boss' for gold medal achievers in Wii Play whilst the intense black tanks packs a fierce punch and not to be trifled with when going up against them!

On top of all this, Wee Tanks introduces boss tanks that have their own advanced mechanics and various new ones, some still basic but adding more diverse threats like a three-bullet shotgun blast or slow black bullets that can't be destroyed with your own bullets unlike the others that explode like mines upon impact whilst others are much more out there up to and including the ability to periodically summon new tanks into the field to ambush you and even those that teleport and stun you with electric orbs among others, all whilst featuring five entire difficulties, ranging from being a touch easier than the original game's difficulty all the way to bordering on Kaizo levels of challenging! 

Now take it from me here, I generally consider myself experienced as a gamer so it pains me to say that I couldn't even reach round 20 on the standard 'kid' difficulty and had to resort to playing on the easiest 'toddler' mode to get by. And even then, I could not get past round 30 at the start all by myself! This is thankfully where a most beloved part of Wee Tanks comes into play as this is more or less designed to be played with friends in mind, given how brutal the later levels can be on any difficulty that isn't the easiest of the five.

Before you fret about the possibilities of needing to pair up with friends to actually enjoy this, Studio Kit has you covered as they featured the use of AI companions, up to three and entirely at your discretion as to whether you want to use them or not, as these are true lifesavers for anyone who isn't great at these types of fast-action indies since they make use of a certain system in this game that is quite ingenious in how it aids you outside of purely bragging rights.

Initially I had thought this was tied into what cosmetics you used based on their tiers, but I can confirm that this is not the case and is likely instead based on your level as this goes up by gaining XP via reaching checkpoints in the campaign and any in-game achievements boosting this by a one-off larger amount. This being confirmed when I was unable to 'dumb down' the AI back to when I first used them by switching out said cosmetics as I figured they would amount to little more than handy metal-shields that could revive me about 1 in 30 times as a means of making the game progression just a bit easier for myself. However, by the time I got to trying out the hard 'Adult' difficulty, not only were they coming to my aid FAR more consistently but they even did feats of skill that I, myself, couldn't pull off nearly as well!

Not forgetting about cosmetics though, this is another aspect of Wee Tanks that I quite like as these are bought via 'marbles' which are earned in a manner similar to that of XP and can be bought in a 'hub world' of sorts aptly named Tankey Town. This not only doubles as a risky way of giving you extra cash via roulette slot machines and some fun target practice on the side via a minigame but actually *triples* as what I can only describe as a 'Grand Theft Auto' game mode where shooting at any of the passive tanks results in the screen blaring red sirens as increasingly aggressive and advanced tanks begin honing on your position in an attempt to take you out!

And that's not even beginning with how much other content there is, be it the separate survival game mode that takes place in multiple maps which takes a nice spin on the iconic Call of Duty 'zombies' mode or various extra challenges provided by the developers in the form of 'custom campaigns' that one can try out, even having a shot at making one of your own via their excellent level editor that practically gives you everything you need to make your own fun missions in classic Wii tanks form!

Outside of the difficulty spike when playing solo and certain achievements being unclear on how to unlock (some require you to not use AI companions to be eligible for them) alongside it taking a while to get used to the tactical shooter style of gameplay and the view of perspective on the field, I've had a great time revisiting this gem from the past brought back as a modern indie and highly encourage borrowing more great gaming ideas from the famous powerful 'dragon' and its horde of treasures from the far east if it means getting more fantastic games in the future!

Dwarfenstein是一款第一人称射击游戏，主要游戏剧情是在作为一个在太空中漫游的矮人，在一个机器人的引导下不断战斗。作为一款第一人称射击游戏，Dwarfenstein还融入了塔防玩法，有着从固定刷新点汹涌而来的怪物和需要保卫的基地。
游戏中的矮人可以选择枪手、工程师和电工三个职业，每个职业都有自己独特的武器和技能系统，但天赋点是三个角色共用的。游戏一共有三个大关卡，每个大关卡里有三到四个小关卡，每个关卡又分三种难度，打赢每个关卡可以收集到蓝色水晶，游戏内也可以开采并吸取水晶，水晶是解锁武器、天赋、技能的唯一途径，所以说游戏还是有点小肝的——如果卡关需要刷前面的关卡赚水晶，不过整体难度还是比较低的，需要保卫的基地血非常足，而矮人可以无限复活，怪物拆家速度说实话很慢，目前我个人一路平推没输过一局。
游戏的数值设定说实话还是有点让人不舒服的——第一世界的石头巨人血量肉到让人恶心，不打人只拆家，但拆家速度又不快，完全可以不处理石头人，打完小怪再回头来打；投石的石巨人伤害又高的离谱，一个石头直接满血秒；第一世界的最终骑士BOSS弱到离谱，只会投石头，无脑围着它跳百分百满血过关，希望加强一下。
游戏有一定BUG，怪物可能会在一些奇奇怪怪的地方卡住，但是无伤大雅，工程师的左轮等武器有严重的准心不正确，瞄着打但是弹道会奇怪的固定往旁边偏，这点比较影响游戏体验，希望能尽快改好。
另外一个小技巧：复活是满血，如果快刷完一波但是血量很残，可以养一两个蠕虫之类的小怪，然后送了等复活，满血打下一波。总的来说，作为一个打磨了四年的游戏，整体质量还是过硬，希望开发组继续加油，扩充一下游戏内容和职业，最好让技能和武器也可以通过蓝色水晶升级一下伤害或者效果。

I've played this game a lot since it first released in early access and continued to iterate on the game.  The end result, at least of their 1.0, is that they just never addressed so many of the myriad problems with the game.

Weapon balance is terrible.  It has always been terrible since the early days and has barely been addressed.  A large percentage of the weapons are so bad they actively make you weaker by having them, since you get offered upgrades for your other weapons less often.  Some weapons are so strong that they will carry an entire run by themselves.

Visibility is terrible.  There is no mechanism to see aliens which are visually behind something.  The game has an isometric style, where the camera is top down but slanted in a way that you see the bottom side of things, but not the top.  Any aliens "north" of terrain are completely invisible.  This extends to being behind the escort vehicle, mineable resources, trees, crystals, etc.  Weapon effects also render over top of enemies.  You will routinely take damage from running into enemies that have never been visible on your screen.

Information availability is terrible.  Do you know want to know which weapons are available to the scout?  Too bad.  Do you want to know the stats of a weapon you're about to select from a level-up?  Too bad.  Do you want to know how much damage your existing weapon does?  First, you have to ESC, then click into each individual weapon.  Next, damage over time is not credited to the source weapon whatsoever.  If you're any kind of status effect build, all of the damage pools into one giant damage type that you can't even view until the postgame screen.  There is no way to know how much damage each of your fire weapons is contributing.

Meta progression is ridiculous.  I have millions of credits and thousands of each meta resource from playing so much in early access.  You now not only have meta upgrades, but also gear that randomly drops during the game.  These items have *enormous* pools of stats and can cost a few hundred thousand credits to fully upgrade.  One of the item types is the only way for a class to have access to more weapon types, so you're unable to even go down that route until you RNG them.

A piece of gear can have 60 armor or >100 hp in addition to multiple other stats.  A legendary armor upgrade in game is 15 armor.  Armor has a dramatic dropoff in effectiveness, so not only does armor become a completely wasted upgrade in game, but if you don't have these big pieces you're going to be taking 4x the incoming damage.  Keep in mind that even with this much armor you can still take half or more of your hp in a single hit from big enemies on danger 5.

The amount of weapons / tag spread is too small.  You naturally want your weapons to overlap in as many ways as possible so that you can maximally share the category upgrades.  For example, 20% projectile damage gives more benefit if all 4 weapons use projectiles than with just 2.  However, there aren't actually that many weapons with good overlap.  Outside of kinetic and projectile, there are pitifully few for many of the other types.  Some weapons have upgrades that change their damage type, but you can't plan around that since there's a high chance it doesn't appear and many of those that change type are in the "these weapons suck" category.  Between the general power (or lack thereof) for some weapons, and the availability of synergistic options, you end up building toward the same options far too often.

The game is cheap.  It's an OK game to play here and there, but it quickly becomes an exercise in frustration due to all the never addressed issues.

Оружия много и оно разнообразно. Будь то автоматическое, оставляемое, летающее, взрывающееся... А помимо этого - ещё различные типы урона и различных тегов. [h2]Типы биомов и миссии[/h2]
В игре несколько биомов, которые хорошо отличаются друг от друга.
Они отлично справляются со своей задачей - помогают менять тактику игры.

Практически каждая миссия имеет уникальное требование для полного прохождения - будь то прохождение на определённом классе, с определёнными тегами на оружии, или с повышением всего оружия до определённого уровня. Они хорошо дополняют миссии, и не мешают получать удовольствие от игры.

Ведь остальные плюсы либо не особо влияют на ощущение от игры, либо достаточно противоречивы. А вот о минусах есть что рассказать...

[h1] Минусы продукта[/h1]
[h2]Настройки игры[/h2]
Начнём с самой базы - настройки, которые невозможно победить. Ведь как можно победить то, чего в игре нет?
У нас есть ОГРОМНОЕ количество мобов и количество эффектов на экране.
Качество графики и прорисовку мобов изменить нельзя. Эффекты не то что отключить - их даже уменьшить нельзя. Вам приказано страдать. И Вашей системе тоже. Сочувствую людям со Steam Deck.
Настройки управления отсутствуют. Вы не можете поставить оставляемое изделие по нажатию кнопки - Вам необходимо остановиться. Вы не можете стрелять некоторым оружием в нужную Вам сторону, просто повернув персонажа при помощи второго стика - перемещайте Дворфа при помощи движения.

[h2]Улучшение персонажа[/h2]
Со временем, появляется возможность навсегда улучшить прокачку в биоме, на Дворфе или оружии.
К прохождению биомов претензий нет - прохождение лёгкая и награда небольшая.
Награда же за Дворфов и оружие считаю просто смехотворной, особенно по отношению к приложенным усилиям.
Мало того что карта, на который Вы играете за Дворфа намного меньше стандартной, вдобавок мы получает невозможность лечиться при повышении уровня или от естественной регенерации. А ещё нас встречает "особенность" в виде отсутствия десантной капсулы на некоторых этапах. В награду получите +5% интенсивности на оружие или +7% опыта за данного дворфа. А может, что похуже :)
С оружием - ещё большая проблема. Представим, что у нас более 30 видов различного вооружения. В рамках повышения оружия, Вам выдаётся только это оружие и только один оружейный слот. Да, с некоторым вооружением так поиграться очень даже приятно - такой режим позволяет понять полезность конкретного оружия. Но есть моменты, портящие впечатление от такого повышения.

- Повысить можно только одно оружие за раз. Большое количество вооружения просто повторяют повышение некоторой/некоторых характеристик, не привнося никаких "уникальных способностей". Логичный вопрос - помимо того, чтобы пощупать оружие, на кой сделана такая система? Чтобы Дворфы понимали, на какую корпорацию работают? Похоже, них нет чести! Нет уважения! Нет пива! (Ведь его нет) А если серьёзно - объединить повышение пачки вооружения под теги, и всё бы стало замечательно.

- Неизвестно, зачем дана возможность повышения оружия на уровне сложности 4 и ниже, когда они дают меньший бонус мастерства. Более непонятно: Какие к чёрту +7% к интенсивности или +5% к скорострельности? Вы совсем там конкурентов перенюхали?
[i] Возможно [/i] можно и было бы закрыть на это глаза. Но не тогда, когда в бета версии игры, бонусы могли доходить до +30%. Тогда это чувствовалось и был смысл "закрывать" всё оружие. Сейчас я в этом смысла особого не вижу, кроме выбивания достижений.

- Особенность некоторого вооружения. Я разделяю оружие в этой игре на три типа: "Основной урон", "Поддержка" и "Зачем мне вообще нужно это оружие?".
С оружием из разряда "Основной урон" всё понятно - они отлично себя показывают в таких условиях.
С оружием "Поддержка" - сложнее. Сугубо из-за того, что оно может быть не очень предназначено для нанесения большого количества урона по одной цели, либо не может контролировать толпу. А может, когда у Вас из вооружения только оно - становится сложно быстро повышать уровни или возникают проблемы с убийством боссов. (Например гранаты, которые очень любят вылетать за границы карты, взрываясь в пустоте (Но я их всё равно обожаю! Они такие замечательные :з)).
А тип "Зачем мне вообще нужно это оружие?" - замените на максимально Дфорфо-матерное выражение, и не прогадаете. Я сюда отношу любой тип оружия, который сам по себе настолько плох, что без хайрола в модификациях, появляющихся боссах и усилений с капсулы не разобраться. Таким хайролом можно считать "дополнительное оружие", которое можно получить. Да, у нас тут миссия с одним оружием, но при везении, можно обзавестись ещё одним, ломая суть миссии.

- Невостребованные бонусы / Невозможность использования бонусов. Выпадающие усиления не соответствуют типу миссии. Вам могут предложить модификацию к скорострельности в ущерб скорости перемещения, когда в данной миссии используется только оружие без скорострельности как таковой. Более ужасный вариант - невозможность получить бонусы за синергию однотипных тегов. Пример: Оружие с тегом "Изделие" имеет "время действия". Общее время действия всех изделий можно продлить, если у Вас будет таких 2 или больше. Представьте, что у вас есть дроны, которые имеют уникальную черту (которая получается при определённом повышении уровня и если её выбрать), которая позволяет превращать их во взрывающихся дронов. Время действия выступает в этом случае противоположным эффектом - чем больше время действия работы, тем оно меньше. И Вы, для увеличения урона, хотите иметь время жизни дронов как можно меньше. Но извините - у Вас только одно оружие с тегом "изделие", и увеличить время жизни Вы не сможете.
[h2] Артефакты[/h2]
В них нет баланса. По факту "тебе необходимо найти это и это, иначе с огромной долей вероятности ты не сможешь убить последнего босса". Некоторая часть бонусов действительно ситуативны и могут помочь, но большая их часть либо бесполезны, либо просто НИТРОВУХА, ради которой нужно просто собирать свой билд.
[h2] А что по сложности?[/h2]
Всё плохо. Между сложностью 3 и 4, видна огромная пропасть. И не из-за того, что Вы плохо играете. А из-за прокачки. Вам необходимы вещи. Фармите, страдайте.
Лазурный биом и аналог взрывников - максимально безбожная штука. Быстро бегающие взрывные особи, которые спавнятся не в единичном экземпляре, и способные спокойно нанести 70+ урона, иногда просто способны тебя догнать и убить без шанса на спасение.

[h3]И в главных ролях[/h3]
- Тип миссии "Сопровождение". Вы не пройдёте, ведь чем раньше Вы будете играть на сложности 5 - тем быстрее прокачаетесь. Обновление в помойку.
- Модификаторы ежедневных и еженедельных миссий. Описание одно - по факту, ещё куча всего, о чём Вам не сообщили. Описания не найдёте. Спасибо!

There's a lot with this game so I'm just gonna to a pros and cons list:

Pros:
- As of 2025 standards, the game is visually stunning.
- Weekly/Monthly challenges so there's reason to come back in check in.
- Some of these cars are FUN to drive. Controller or wheel some of these cars are just a blast to use.
- Again as of 2025 standards, the system requirements are pretty broad so you can kind of play this game on anything.

Cons:
- It's nice that there's a butt ton of cars... But like 40% of them feel like hot garbage to control, and most people don't wanna spend hours to make their car feel good to drive in.
- Car availability is HORRIFIC!!! You want a certain car that's not in the autoshow? Pray it's in the auction house and have an extra 20mil credits ready to hopefully buy it out before someone else does. You can literally game the system and earn credits faster by scalping and reselling cars in the auction house compared to actually playing the game.
- (This is a Steam specific issue) If you buy Horizon off steam and want to play it on your Xbox you have to buy the game again on the Xbox storefront. It's an "Xbox play anywhere" title so it should support this, but this is a totally separate issue that's from my understanding on Steam's end and not Microsoft's.

- Bots have overran the leaderboards. So don't expect a top 10% in anything

Long story short:
This is a Horizon title, so the game's a really fun casual experience to play solo or with friends. If you're looking for a more realistic racing sim experience, this game ain't it (Assetto Corsa is more what you're looking for).

Forza Horizon 5 é um jogo de corrida excepcional. Ainda não é superior ao 3 e ao 4, mas ele entrega muita coisa que realmente é divertido de se jogar. Como um grande fã de Forza Horizon, tendo zerado todos, com exceção do segundo que já não está mais disponível assim como todos os anteriores), eu realmente gostei do quinto título. 

O sistema de missões dele é diferente dos anteriores. Agora não temos uma campanha com uma história fixa, como de ganhar fãs no primeiro ou de manter o festival ativo como no 3. O sistema de missões é através de capítulos do Horizon, onde você tem vários objetivos por capítulos subdivididos. Alguns são interessantes, outros nem tanto, mas tudo isso complementado com missões de corrida de rua, off-road, etc. 

Mesmo não sendo o meu sistema de missões favorito, o jogo continua a brilhar com sua jogabilidade impecável. Não existe nenhum jogo de corrida no mercado que conseguiu trazer uma dirigibilidade tão impressionante e simples como em FH. Você pode escolher tanto o modo arcade como o simulador para o controle do veículo, mas o padrão é equilibrado. Caso queira algo mais próximo dos Motorsport, vai ter que fuçar nas configurações, mas não é nada muito complicado, só tem que ter uma noção básica do que é o que e como funciona cada coisa.

Quanto aos gráficos, o jogo é belissímo em todos os sentidos. O mapa novo é no México e conseguiram equilibrar tanto com cidades, estradas e zonas rurais sem ficar algo chato. Nos anteriores já era assim, mas eles mantiveram esse padrão, o que é um ponto mais que positivo. No geral, é um dos jogos mais bonitos da geração e é facilmente o mais bonito dos jogos de corrida (principalmente no quesito otimização). A ambientação é muito rica e você se impressiona com vários lugares que você passa. Nada é tão incrível nesse jogo quanto a sensação de imersão ao dirigir pelas estradas do México ouvindo a rádio. Só jogue!

Quanto aos problemas e bugs, eu dificilmente enfrentei algum problema com o jogo. A performance é ótima, roda muito bem e sem quedas de FPS, porém, pode rolar um travamento leve de vez em quando. No geral, é um excelente trabalho de otimização e que não passou batido.

A trilha sonora é um charme a parte. O jogo traz várias rádios com diferentes estilos, indo desde o clássico, até o eletrônico e o rock. É o tipo de jogo que você conhece muita música boa e já adiciona na sua playlist fora do game. E claro, os efeitos sonoros dos veículos são espetaculares e dão um brilho a nossa experiência. 

No final das contas, FH5, apesar de possuir um sistema de objetivos que não me agradou tanto, não é algo que estraga ou invalida a experiência total com o game. Ele ainda traz duas DLCs, incluindo o retorno de Hot Wheels e foi sensacional fazer 100% de ambas. Jogue FH5, mas compre-o em uma promoção, porque mesmo o jogo sendo sensacional, não compensa pagar os 250 ou 400 reais na versão definitiva com o preço cheio.

Take even the most cursory glance online and you can easily find a torrent of hate for this game, but you won't find it here.

I enjoyed this game very much by taking my time to savour it and really ensure I was following every development closely.
A lot of players fall off the rails with this game because they don't hold on tight enough, or for some reason want it to follow real-world logic rigidly, a strange ask, given that players of this game presumably have at least some experience of the magic-laden Corpse Party universe by now.

I highly recommend immersing oneself deeply in the gory warm bath of [i]Corpse Party (2021), Book of Shadows, and Sweet Sachiko's Hysteric Birthday Bash [/i] before playing this. Yes, you will lose a lot by not having played those games thoroughly beforehand.

I would also encourage you to play this on PC! Wonderful, you're reading this on Steam, so you almost certainly will be.

I say the above because a lot of this game's negative reputation comes from the appalling mess it was released in, and left in, for years on console. Oh console, how heavy your sins!

This isn't to say the game is a flawless masterpiece now—certainly not, but it's a lot better than the cynics and hate–train bandwagoners would have you believe.
It has a fantastic ending and genuinely great story beats all throughout.
This game includes some of the best extra chapters in the whole series and when "Harewataru Sora" begins to play in the Epilogue, it really hits perfectly... like the fragile hope that dares to hint at dawn after the oppressive darkness of Heavenly Host.

Some puzzles are particularly hard… well, that's always been Corpse Party; the infamous bug pit from Game 1 set the standard for that.
Some things are a little finicky to interact with again, that's par for the course.

Maybe the new characters upset you?
Some villains are irredeemable; not everyone needs to be shades of grey.

As for Magari and Kuon, Magari is larger than life but nothing unusual for this series, really.
Kuon is very strange, yes, but remind yourself: she was created by the curse to replace Ms. Yui. Feeling otherworldly and unnatural is deliberate—she was literally written into existence by magic.
Accepting that is table stakes for the story, so complaining about her "weirdness" feels oddly selective. She isn't an ordinary woman.

Perhaps you simply don't like where the story goes and feel strongly that [i] if only [b] you [/b] [/i] had written it, then it would be different and much better in your humble opinion…

Overall, this is a great telling of Kedouin's vision for how the Heavenly Host saga ends, at least for now.
I personally think it tells its story very well.

Yes, this is one of those "do or do not, there is no try" kind of games: either commit to this as a lover, or don't bother with it—as you'll only get hurt if you go in for a quick fling.

遗老玩家一名，大改玩法后现在根本就不想玩了。第一，管你什么武器，体验想要好就得走官方新版本强推的堆元素伤害玩法，很多以前的有趣流派直接报废，我玩的是o神嘛在那里毒火雷满天飞的，1关一出，白色伤害数字直接匿迹；第二，宝藏大改大削，伤害分布由以前的低频高伤变成了现在的高频低伤，曾经沧海难为水，这种数字的落差个人难以接受。其实你可以同时保留新老版本，玩家萝卜青菜各有所爱，一棍子打死老玩法不是所有人都会接受和适应。总之，还是感谢这游戏之前给我带来的快乐吧！

如果你是一代老资历，那么二代相比一代确实是非常大的进步。难度梯度在深度3以前都很合理，但是一到深度3就会变成在第四大关前都很刮痧的情况，而且如果是多人3-4人的情况下，boss的数值将会非常夸张。藏品发育方面也是第一大关和第二大关的发育几乎等于没有，全靠基本功硬打过去，虽然通关不是问题，但是会变成刮痧or乱杀就看你第三关第四关的藏品够不够格。举个例子，本人单人深度3，最快可以18分钟通关，最慢的一次是40分钟。如果可以强化一下前两关对于发育的重要性，整个游戏流程将会十分爽快。在武器平衡方面一般，尤其点名批评双刀，数值差的没法看。明明是全游戏操作难度和涡压炮并列第一的武器，伤害却永远低人一等，付出与收益完全不成正比。总而言之，游戏整体比较优秀，部分细节缺少深度打磨，有朋友一起会非常好玩。

思来想去，一直在好评和差评里面徘徊，最终还是选择给个差评吧。这游戏CG少，然后剧情也可有可无，社保方面也少的可怜，实在搞不懂这游戏还能卖那么贵，顶多十块都算顶价了，甚至我觉得这比起一大瓶可乐的购买金额都嫌多，其次我觉得唯一的一个优点就是可以进回想房直接开启全CG，除此之外我实在找不到其它优点了，剧情看着真就白开水，讲述了一个你在商店图看到的清纯可爱妹子如何变成hentai的过程，关键是最后有个CG竟然还会卡，我卸载重新安装不打补丁继续过那个CG依然如此，这也是为什么我两小时通关的原因，实际上可能顶天一个半小时就通关(你甚至还能为此退款，乐)，所以有这钱买这游戏的人建议去买份KFC疯狂星期四炸鸡桶都比这个值。

野兽的献祭出牌系列，复卡是松鼠，特点是献祭召唤以及缝合怪物，

Скажу сразу, игра мне и моим друзьям в целом понравилась, пишу обзор в надежде, что разработчик увидит и допилит/исправит то, что на мой взгляд портит впечатление от игры.
1. Баг с настройками биндов, эта прокрутка вниз, когда пытаешься на колесико мыши интуитивно найти нужную настройку - по итогу тебя выкидывает за область, где ты физически не можешь никак перебиндить ни одну из кнопок, это окно нужно ограничить по размеру, как это сделано во многих играх.
2. Баг с интерфейсом, как раз в тех же самых биндах, где у тебя тупо не отображаются буквы на клавиатуре, в управлении и тебе это нужно держать в голове, это глупо, так быть не должно и обязательно нужно фиксить.
3. Баг, когда ты уезжаешь, но тебя кусает монстр в момент, когда начинается процедурная генерация поезда в безопасной зоне (я будучи хостом застрял в воздухе и не мог сдать весь лут, а после пересоздания лобби в том же сейве - у меня не сохранился он).
4. Баг, который случился после бага описанного выше, суть в том, что мои друзья не могли закупаться в магазине (их начало выкидывать с сервера и терялся лут), возможно эти 2 бага связаны, типа забагованный сейв.
Теперь к тому, чего не хватает в геймплейном плане:
Во-первых, биом, где ты в морозе вынужден искать костер, чтобы согреться - нужно увеличить кол-во времени, когда ты можешь находиться на холоде (+30-60 или даже больше секунд, нужно проверять), либо увеличивать кол-во бочек на локации.
Во-вторых, момент, когда монстр с пилой тебя тащит - нужно добавить механику, где игрок может сопротивляться и вырываться, замедляя для монстра возможность затащить тебя на крюк, выигрывая время для друзей, которым очень тяжело тебя спасти (на практике невозможно, ввиду наличия других монстров и ловушек), возможность вырываться с крюка ценою своей собственной жизни, а не просто сдача.
Третий момент - биом с растениями, когда тебя отправляют в карманное измерение и ты теряешь все свои вещи, что очень сильно усложняет геймплей, когда ты играешь с усложнением без света, там буквально ничего не видно, напрашивается другой момент, о котором напишу ниже.
Четвертый момент - покупка за какую-то сумму игровой карты, не обязательно слишком большой, просто чтобы игроку было чуть удобнее ориентироваться по карте, на мой взгляд наличие кучи монстров, которые бегают без усталости, которых нельзя убить и лишь можно застанить - делают игру довольно сложной, карта бы хорошо вписалась в эту игру (можно даже без отметок ловушек, а более дорогую и апгрейднутую версию с наличием ловушек).
В остальном - мне понравилась атмосфера, рация реализована круто, монстры действительно пугают и довольно мерзкие, дизайн уровней хорош, но карт становится мало, музыка в лифте зачет, игра цепляет и если доработать эти нюансы, пофиксить баги, то я бы мог спокойно рекомендовать её всем, а пока что это игра для тех, кто готов с друзьями 5-10 часов бороться/мириться с трудностями, которые встречаются на каждом шагу.

A turn based Xianxia game highly reminiscent of Tale of Immortal but without the janky translations and with a more coherent story. It's not finished yet, but what exists is already worth the asking price in my opinion.

Genuinely a very good xianxia cultivation game. So far there is a lot of content - you will certainly get your money's worth. 

The different game systems work decently well together. To progress your cultivation (your character power)  you need to use elixirs and other crafted items. To craft these items you need materials which you can get through battles and having your own garden. This loop repeats itself throughout the game but each cultivation stage it gets more complex and additional requirements are added so the progression path never really becomes stale.

The higher your progression the more skills you unlock, the more skills you can apply during battle. There are different combat schools unlocking a lot of different builds and ways to fight. However at later stages of the game building your character can get decently complex as also equipment gets put into the equation. You learn how different schools function over the course of the game but the evolution of a build is not always very clear cut. The systems provide a high level of freedom and customization but this can be overwhelming for some. For people that don't want to bother with this there are builds on the public discord of the game. But be aware that the game will become more and more grindy which can be a plus to some and a con to others.

But while there are many different builds you dont really see a big difference in the battles itself. The different skills sadly only have very very basic animations. The battles become just a sequence of action names that get executed.  I wish the fights would be more grandiose and epic to fulfill the power fantasy. Sadly the artworks of the monsters you battle are also AI generated (aswell as a lot/most (if not all) of the game art in general). The AI assets are not extremely jarring but one certainly notices it and it does decrease immersion. Hopefully this changes in the future but I dont know if the developers have any concrete plans to commission their own atwork.

To end on a positive note: the developers a very active on their discord and their plans and changes seem very reasonable. You can see that they put thought into it. So while the game is still in early access I have trust in them and in the game's current state its still worth its price tag. So even if the development would completely stop I would not feel cheated out of my money.

I give this a thumbs up very tentatively. The game is super basic and barebones right now, but the devs are very active and have been updating the game weekly. The concept is there and really cool. Flying around the city is super fun, but repetition sets in really, really quickly. It's essentially petty crimes from spider man if that's all you could do, which would be fine if the combat was interesting or even involved, but it just boils down to mashing the attack button on spongy enemies with incredibly slow combos. Villain boss fights do break up the monotony and they're definitely the highlight, with some giving a great sense of scale against the city. UI is really clunky, there's no reason that "powers" and "achievements" should be on two seperate menus. I shouldn't have to back out of one menu to see what I unlock next level, why not just have one long linear menu showing what can be unlocked? I don't mean to be overly negative, I definitely got £8 worth of enjoyment out of it, but I'd recommend waiting and seeing where the game is at a year from now. I like what is here so far, but I think it was released too early. Everything needs more. More missions, more depth to combat, better UI, more depth to the "human" aspect. I respect what has been done here with such a small team and I'm excited to see what the game will look like down the line.

I'm not usually the one to make reviews or comments on games, so this is a first for me.

Master of Command scratches an itch that most RTS games don't really hit on. I've played almost all Total War games and Gates of Hell, and finally Men of War. I'm not truly great at RTS for that matter, but I find this game really enjoyable. I wanted to make a review on the things that I enjoyed and the things that I disliked, and also comment on some other people's reviews as well.

Positives:
- What I enjoy about this game is that its a mix between realism and straight up a cartoon-esque experience. It's fun to have unique scenarios that provide a multitude of benefits depending on what you have. For example, I managed to recruit French infantry by having the rights doctrines and equipment. 

- The variety of equipment. This is something I enjoyed more than I thought I would've had. It feels like you have control of your own personal army in which you do ofc. Many games like Total War only apply this factor to generals and even then, customization is relatively limited and equipment is already preset for infantry and cavalry, etc. 

- Army customization and naming. I spent like an hour just customizing my army and my officer staff. I divided them into division colors and mentally made the staff have their own unique personality. I renamed the head of the staff just for him to die bravely in combat. This game for me makes me have this sense of connection with a unit just because I customized them myself. In Total War, you just have blobs of armies with no true personality or connection other than the general or lord. 

- Size and Scale. This game had me thinking I just completed the impossible in the first region alone. I fought and won against the enemy HQ not thinking it was the HQ, and I won. I thought, that was a campaign down and I was done. Nope, there was more to come and I was suffering from the cost from the previous engagement. The scale is nice and having only one army is really refreshing and allows you to have that bond with the army you created.

- Veteran tree. I feel so accomplished whenever my recruit unit becomes a Life Guard Unit. I feel like a proud parent seeing my child finally become something for themselves. The tree is not too expansive. You have the cavalry, artillery, or infantry which is divided into line, grenadiers, or skirmishers depending on the unit. It's not too complicated to understand and know what you want depending on army composition. 

- Art Style. Not much to say here honestly. As a big Armchair Historian fan, I love seeing their art style implemented in a game like this. I have been anticipating for this game for a while and I'm very impressed. 

- Challenging in a good way. I maybe bad at these types of games, but I really had fun with this game. Total war doesn't challenge me that much for some reason (I do not play on legendary difficulty.) But the game Master of Command at first makes the fighting really difficult at first. I only have played the Prussians and I find myself running away from every patrol till I got stronger and managed to fight them. 

Finally, my complaints of the game so far.

- Bugs. Right now, middle of the campaign, my clicker vanished but it comes back when I exit the game. So it is impossible for me to even save the game. Thankfully (I think), this game does a good job at auto-saving constantly. I had an issue where my cavalry wouldn't even respond to my command and when I select them by drawing over them it wouldn't even select the unit.

- Enemy AI and composition. The enemy is not all that realistic and kind of ruins the fun of fighting. The enemy tends to focus heavily on cavalry and tons of artillery. Artillery just mows your line down, and I always run only 2 artillery pieces because who has fun playing games with just OP cannons. It might be a feature though since a ton of armies at this time always bombards before attacking, however, AI in this game just refuses to attack. I pushed forward with my line infantry and they backed up into their own cannons. Like mentioned in a comment, the cavalry just charges head on and dies, wasting their own general for meaningless attacks. I do like how cavalry focuses heavily on your cavalry. It reminds me of total war a bit. 

- AI Formation (after reading reviews). The AI I noticed don't seem to form in different formation. I do like how AI units have items like you do as well, but they don't adapt or use them much. I see them always in a straight line or a blob sometimes. 

- Repetitive after a bit. This is honestly probably my own choice and error. I feel that when I'm fighting in a battle, I have to resort to the same strategy I always have been doing, just because the AI is either too defensive or too aggressive. It'd be interesting to see them actually use the terrain to their advantage and move to key points. I always make the largest line of infantry and just move forward like a wave and win. That is highly me own issue, but I want to feel like I have to adapt to an enemy's attack and charge. 

Now to comment on some of the reviews:

I feel that people don't understand that this game just got released yesterday. It's a good game and there are a few bugs here and there that make it less fun, but that is to be expected. Now, calling the game boring because your entire army is artillery is kind of an awful take. Artillery is really busted in this game and having an army entirely of artillery ruins the whole point of a game like this. It's similar to what we call "doom-stacking" in Total War. You just stack OP units and auto-resolve to win. Diversify and you'll have fun.

I like comparing things to games I like, and even though MoC isn't total war, what other game can replicate line warfare and the Age of Reason like Total War. Total War Empire was my first ever game and tbh, I played it how I currently do in MoC. I'm a sucker for infantry. I do understand that scaling and the team really varies among the two games, but people compare it to Total War because a lot of games like this are very niche or aren't the same style of RTS.

People saying this game revolutionized aspects of RTS I feel are over-exaggerating. This game is amazing don't get me wrong. Its a breath of fresh air to be able to customize units and compose your army, but I feel that its just that, a breath of fresh air. I love the game so far, and I hope they make more updates and more units or campaigns. 

Final Notes:
I love this game and I love the era. As of current, I'm still playing this game but stuck behind a bug or maybe my own user-error, who knows. As someone who needed more content like Empire but different, this was the right game for me. I adore this game and its difficulty, but the hype around it is a little over the top. People saying its realistic and revolutionizes the game are not wrong, but they are not right. I wish Armchair Historian and team the best and I do recommend this game if you want a taste of the time-period and unique style. 

TLDR: Buy the game for style, time period, and personal bond to army. Your experience depends on what you make of it and expect bugs early on and updates soon.

It honestly feels like someone took everything that used to drive me insane in Total War and just… fixed it.

Battles are actually fun now. Once you get a bit further, all the little things—weapon ranges, veterancy, equipment bonuses—start to matter. There’s a ton to mess around with, try out, and occasionally completely screw up (and that’s half the fun).

The campaign feels alive, too. When you can’t replenish in time or realize you’ve got no cavalry left, you really have to adapt or you’re toast. What you do actually matters, and that’s so refreshing for this kind of game.

I’ve played Ultimate General a lot as well, but Master of Command just hits harder when it comes to making choices matter. It gives you more room for creative, dynamic battles instead of just repeating the same tactics.

And best of all—no more chasing that one last headless ashigaru across the entire map because the AI forgot how to exist. Battles end when they should.

Sure, it’s not as massive or richly developed as Total War, but the tight, smart game loops totally make up for it. It’s lean, clever, and genuinely fun from fight to fight.

F.E.A.R. 2: Project Origin delivers a solid first person shooter experience that holds up remarkably well. The visuals are impressive for its time, offering clean presentation and smooth performance that make firefights both cinematic and satisfying. Technically, the game feels well put together, and the overall polish gives it a level of quality that’s easy to appreciate even years later. Where the game stumbles a bit is in its storytelling. The plot and characters get the job done they move things forward but they never quite reach the depth or emotional weight that could have elevated the experience. It’s all serviceable, but not especially memorable. Perhaps the most unexpected thing about F.E.A.R. 2 is how little it leans into actual horror. Despite the name and the franchise’s reputation, the scares are surprisingly mild. Instead of the nerve wracking tension that defined the original, the sequel opts for more straightforward action. That shift might disappoint players who came looking for genuine fear and psychological dread. That said, what F.E.A.R. 2 lacks in horror, it more than makes up for in gameplay. Combat is the star of the show fast, responsive, and full of variety. The weapons feel great, the slow-motion mechanic still hits hard, and encounters remain exciting from start to finish. There’s a strong sense of rhythm to the firefights, blending tactical movement and raw firepower in a way that few shooters managed at the time. I do prefer the first, mostly I guess because I like having a lean toggle but its a solid consolized sequel.

If you play F.E.A.R. 2 immediately after playing the first game, then you'll be disappointed very fast.

Jump/Die/Live
Ranking: A
Difficulty: Hard
A unique platformer where you jump only by clicking and dragging a direction to jump. The amount the player will jump depends on how far you drag the mouse. There is even an arc that shows approximately where you'll jump. Besides the mouse, there are no other controls, and there's no controlling your character once it's in the air. The game is really polished and has a bit of difficulty curve to it. Lots of unique obstacles combined with an interesting platforming mechanic really makes this game shine. Some of the controls were a bit hard to handle at times, and sometimes the jump arc isn't always accurate. However, it never felt like it was the game's fault whenever I died. It always felt very fair. Overall, a great experience for players looking for a challenging mouse-based platformer.

游戏还处于测试阶段，这个正式版完成度实在太低。
目前版本关于游戏问题，有以下需要注意的地方：
1，矿物的获取率太低了，科技的发展不会提示采矿速度，仍然是两只老鼠用手慢慢挖石头，到了后期缺乏资源的现象变得非常严重，以至于需要几十人当矿工，并且不断的挪动采矿小屋的位置来挖矿，操作非常繁琐。
2，种田几乎没有意义，在极低的填海造陆效率下，四块石头填一格地，再加上极其漫长的清理田里的石头的时间，种田变成了极其高投入的一项工作，但是到了后期缺乏燃料的情况下，又不得不种树，这种情况很容易让游戏在中期就结束，由于缺乏木头导致失败。
3，蒸汽机的使用成本极高，虽然描述写的0.2蒸汽每下，但经过测试，两台蒸汽机可以在一天内把库存的8000蒸汽用完，烧都来不及烧。一台蒸汽机的维持成本是两只种树的老鼠，两只用木头做燃料的老鼠，以及一个专门加燃料的老鼠，但是蒸汽机的效果却只是可怜的100生产力，甚至一只生病的饥饿老鼠都比这高。可以看到制作者并没有玩到过游戏后期。
4，后期卡顿现象严重，尤其是下暴雨的情况下，配置是i9-14900k,rtx4070,后期300人口的情况下只有30fps。
5，火车容量极小，可以看到最近的更新增加了电梯lift的容量，从三人增加到五人，但是火车的容量是不是太小了点呢，一座150人的建筑，出门之后有四分之一天在等火车，而且由于ai问题，并不会选择其他路线，只会傻乎乎在那等到饿死。建议学习工人与苏维埃里面的火车，整个大车厢。
6，一天的时间太短了，建议延长2倍白天时间，让通勤问题不那么明显。
7，研究完所有科技也没有看见船在哪里，以及海盗怎么对付，人口也到达了350，已经卡顿得不行了。
8，可不可以让脚手架自动消失，经常出现挖矿结束后剩下一大堆脚手架在那里，必须存档再读档，然后建造建筑再删除建筑，才能移除脚手架。
9，地下矿物并没有比地上多，这使得玩家没有往下挖的欲望，建议大幅度增加深层矿物。
10，为什么没有简单亲民的大平原小岛开局？在一座全是山的小岛发展让人很难受。

It pains me to write a negative review because I really like the idea of using LLM's for NPC's in video games and I think there is a ton of untapped potential there. However this game does an extremely lackluster job at integrating it. I had more fun putting chat gpt into skyrim with a mod than playing this game. 

The AI is super sterile and rigid and will not enable you to roleplay the way you want. If you chose to be any interesting character, the AI will just not believe you. The AI does not have its own backstory straight, like one playthrough it will say her parents are divorced and next time they are not. It will quickly forget what you talked about recently. It will not react proportionally to what you say to it, for example: I told her I will find her and murder her and her response was along the lines of "that is not okay! ...well anyway let's have small talk about our hobbies?". 

One thing this game does well is include body language, facial expressions and tone of voice changes that fit the dialogue, it's not perfect but it's definitely cool to see. However, the actual responses of the AI feel like a generic LLM was just slapped into the game with a basic prompt. You can have some laughs with it, but it quickly gets boring and there isn't much sense of immersion. 

Verdict: Maybe buy it if you are an AI enthusiast or if the game goes on a big sale. But keep your expectations minimal.

Life is Strange: Before the Storm é a prequela do primeiro jogo focada no relacionamento entre Chloe Price e Rachel Amber. É importante ter jogado o primeiro para entender a história deste. O jogo é mais curto que o primeiro e possui apenas 3 episódios (e mais um DLC), porém eles são um pouco mais longos.

Como a Chloe não possui superpoderes, o jogo usa um sistema de "bate-boca" onde a protagonista escolhe opções para tentar convencer a outra pessoa a fazer o que ela quer. Infelizmente, vencer ou não nos argumentos não faz muita diferença, pois a narrativa é extremamente linear e, embora o jogo frequentemente diga que  "suas ações terão consequências", no fim nenhuma escolha que você fez importou, nem mesmo no final (diferente do primeiro jogo).

Os personagens que não são a Chloe e a Rachel são muito mal aproveitados e o vilão, além de ser extremamente genérico (um traficante violento que quer grana), [spoiler]ele é derrotado de forma anticlimática por outro NPC sem nenhuma intervenção da protagonista (e dependendo da escolha que você fizer no final, ela nem precisava estar ali).[/spoiler]

No fim, Before the Storm é uma oportunidade desperdiçada que acrescenta muito pouco à narrativa do primeiro e poderia simplesmente ter sido uma DLC. 

Não recomendo, infelizmente.

The scene of Tempest play was such a fantastic idea, of both characters talking within the speech-style of Shakespeare yet speak on themselves on their future that awaits. This is a really heart-touching detail the developers have painted into the story line between the two.
Another heart felt scene would be when it is up to Chloe to comfort Rachal after finding out such a outburst of betrayal from ones she loved. 

As we explore more of the details of the gameplay, the designs really feed onto the style of indie/punk which already it self is very unique. The many colours and lighting drastically show the mood set within scenes from the whites and yellows showing a comforting vibe from the dark purples and blues which shows a powerful emotion of sadness or excitement.
The visuals of this game really run well, it almost feels like you are in a picture or even a painting. This really makes the game unique by its touch.
Now for some side characters they really make you feel like the character, building connections with one and another, being able to interact with many options which really puts you into place as Chloe seeing how she speaks with others. Another really nice detail would be the many game side quest and the secretive markings of graffiti, being able to change the clothing of the character?! Now that is what I loved with this game. Now with my all time beloved favourite; the music - the music really pulled the strings on your heart while playing, making you feel the moment with the character, it's hard to hate.
'Life is strange: Before the storm', is honestly a top favourite as it is being set before Max comes along.

好玩！

最初只是抱著想接觸看看口味比較重的成人向遊戲而購入，但是玩著玩著想法就漸漸地改變了，轉而開始認真經營、充實女主角奧蕾蒂的能力，順便解成就。從玩家們提供的評論及攻略得知遊戲偏向鼓勵多周目的玩法，於是一邊抱著「所有的壞結局都是為了更光明的未來」一邊跑完了三次。

以下紀錄了個人瑣碎的遊戲流程及心得，所有評論皆為主觀意見，只代表我自己。

一、遊戲體驗：

二周目走的是墮落線，但是為了讓下一輪的奧蕾蒂能夠以完全體之姿揍扁古洛斯，我還是認真地鍛鍊到能力值全滿、完成五階段的艾洛芬鍛鍊甚至稱霸了鬥技場（不過文本依舊默認奧蕾蒂一直在逃避訓練 XD）
由於墮落線能夠自由活動的天數比正氣線多了不少，閒到可以去搶劫旅行商人，最後兩天簡直無事可做只能跑去賺錢，結果錢也變得超級多。
多虧如此，三周目的奧蕾蒂像含著金湯匙出生一樣，不用去娼館和角鬥場賺錢，只往訓練場衝，再靠主線、支線和嗑藥（靈藥和芳香劑等等）就變完全體了，財富自由技能自由，讚啦。

我想像的最終決戰畫面是壯得和棕熊一樣的奧蕾蒂擋在眾人面前，安慰害怕的珊塔及梅蘭妮：不用擔心，因為我來了。不管是哪一階段的古洛斯傷害都癢得要命，就是這種程度的快感。也許一周目時的艱困打起來反而更有身歷其境的感受ｗ

整體來說，作為一個養成遊戲，我覺得還滿耐玩的。它的養成系統所給予的回饋，讓我願意花時間跑多周目，就如前面所敘述的，成就感十足。

在多周目前提下全成就也不難，另外結局的收集方式和ＣＧ一樣，只要有開過就會紀錄，所以可以不用真的跑七輪，是很親切的設計。

二、劇本：

好看。此種類型的題材並不少見，不管是正氣線還是墮落線的故事發展，都不是什麼嶄新而難以預料的走向。但是我覺得編劇的文筆很好，沒有運用過多辭藻堆砌，也沒有陳腔濫調的表達，讀起來自然流暢，真結局裡姐妹在鬥技場相擁那一幕看第二遍還是會忍不住熱淚盈眶。

主要女性角色們的個性刻畫鮮明立體，價值觀差異導致的衝突描寫非常細膩，有些話裡的言外之意都滿值得細細品味。印象特別深刻的是墮落線最終戰對決艾洛芬時，珊塔出來講話之後艾洛芬的反應。那彷彿在說，她本來就對既悲觀又容易放棄的珊塔不抱希望，正因為如此，才會對終究殊途同歸的奧蕾蒂感到失望。

三、美術和音樂

美術很精緻，聲優的演繹也很細膩。雖然ＣＧ是多位繪師負責因此畫風不一致，但是也可以當作是欣賞不同繪師的風格，滿不錯的。

音樂的部分，即便看了兩次真結局，專屬ＢＧＭ一響還是會讓人忍不住熱血沸騰，我努力了這麼久就是為了看到這個啊！
另外，魔化古洛斯在第十二回合會秒殺奧蕾蒂，但是奧蕾蒂會因此覺醒並得到無限根性，此時背景音樂就會變成有歌詞的版本，非常好聽，練得太強才去打正氣線的話可能會錯過 XD

不過，有一些細節我覺得處理得不夠細膩，比方說主角表情差分、配角立繪和背景兼用的問題。

表情差分的例子：比方說，珊塔生氣的表情好像只有鼓起臉頰那一個，當她表達憤怒時都是用那張臉，但是太可愛了，在某些場合，像是真結局砸毀古洛斯雕像時，情緒就會看起來不到位。

配角立繪的例子：在故事裡有出現名字的配角，例如莫拉、海倫、仙度絲等等，如果可以有她們專屬的立繪就好了，就算只有一個表情也好過拿色違路人造型來呈現，尤其是莫拉連具體形象設定都有了，多個立繪應該不過分吧⋯⋯！

至於背景兼用的問題，像是真結局裡格倫替奧蕾蒂等人安排的旅館用的是原本的奴隸房間場景、旅館附設餐廳用的是原本的酒館場景，還附贈一個被砸爛的古洛斯雕像，這也太出戲了吧 XD

不過，與其說這些是缺點，不如說是我希望能夠優化的部分，屬於個人的吹毛求疵，整體來說完全不影響我遊玩時的心情就是了。

非常愉快的遊戲體驗，謝謝遊戲的製作團隊。

有些致敬其他作品的小彩蛋非常逗趣，作為一個 JOJO 粉，我超喜歡拍賣場後台魔物的支線，太讚了ｗ

Пожалуй это первая игра в жанре меха в которую мне довелось основательно поиграть и пройти.

Геймплей в основном состоит из выполнения миссий на относительно небольших локациях. Чаще всего вам нужно уничтожить противников в виде техники, других мехов или массивных боссов. В целом только сражения с боссами можно назвать интересными, в остальном вы просто летаете и стреляете или рубите врагов которые довольно быстро разлетаются.

Довольно внушительны возможности по созданию вашего меха, можно отдельно менять правые и левые руки, туловища, голову и ноги. От этого ваш мех как может стать тяжелым защищенным и неповоротливым, так и стать быстрым, но хлипким. Набор оружия тоже весьма внушителен от пулеметов, лазеров и огнеметов до мечей с булавами. Но на поздних этапах игры понимаешь что мечи в обоих руках это огромный урон и патроны не кончаются. В бой с собой можно брать 2 оружия в руки и 2 с собой и менять при необходимости, а так же мощную пушку или устройства поддержки.

В плане сюжета мало что понятно, поскольку русского языка нет, но кажется все весьма драматично.

На миссии можно брать с собой напарников со своими мехами, некоторые из них сюжетные, но большинство получаются довольно трудоемко, для этого целый гайд есть.

Играть можно и в кооперативе, но онлайн в игре очень низкий. Эндгейм контент представлен случайно генерируемыми данжами состоящими из пары десятков комнат в которых можно найти уникальные мечи и другое оружие, а так же битвы с усиленными версиями боссов.

В целом игра достаточно средненькая, поиграть можно, но без "вау" эффекта.

A quick note for newcomers, this is a spin-off of Persona 5, not a mainline game. I got confused by all the various names and numbering when I first got into the series, so I get it if you are as well. It's a tactical RPG featuring the cast of P5 and a couple of new characters in an original story. It's set between the final boss of P5 and the epilogue. The pacing of the story is a bit odd, as you're dropped into the action very quickly, but then spend too long a stretch of time in the first area while the plot moves very slowly. The beginning of this game is far more focused on getting you familiar with the gameplay than with the story. This isn't helped by the fact that the Phantom Thieves are supporting players in this story, with the two new characters being the real stars. They're good characters, and by the middle of the game their story has become compelling in its own right, but there's a definite feeling that the Phantom Thieves don't need to be here. It isn't helped that most of them are a bit flanderized here. The comedy relies on exaggerations of their quirks from the original game, and it feels cheap at times.

That said, the story does have some incredible highs. By the end of the game you'll have grown very attached to the two new characters, and tears will be shed at their fate. It's also kind of nice for a Persona game to have a relatively smaller scale the way this one does. It's a nice contrast to P5 Strikers, which went bigger and bolder.

The gameplay is solid. It's not particularly innovative in the TRPG genre, but it's fun. The difficulty is fairly light, with punishments for poor choices not mattering much. The difficulty does increase if you're going for optional objectives, but if you treat the levels like puzzles to be solved, you'll be okay. The sidequests especially demand this, as they'll ask you to clear a map in very particular ways. They're where the game is at its hardest, but they never feel punishing. If Persona 5 was made to be a newcomer's first Persona game, Tactica was clearly made to be a newcomer's first TRPG. It's easy, but in a fun way.

Overall, this is a good game. I recommend it to Persona fans, though I don't know how much anyone who hasn't played Persona 5 will get from this. The gameplay is welcoming, but rewarding if you engage with it. The story is overall good, and despite the exaggerations of the main P5 cast, the characters in this are overall still great to spend time with. I would recommend Strikers over this when it comes to P5 spin-offs, but this one has plenty to offer too.

ポ〇モンなどでもおなじみ、氷の床を滑らせてペンギンをゴールまで運ぶパズルゲーム。

……それに様々なギミックや「パズル選択画面自体がパズルになっている」メタパズル要素がふんだんに盛り込まれておりかなりのボリュームを誇る一作。300以上のパズルがあるのに焼き増し感も無く、毎回新鮮な発見と驚き、そして楽しさを提供してくれる。
最近やったゲームの中でも特に面白い。かなりおすすめ。
（12時間、全パズルの4割程度解き終えた時点でのレビュー）

数々のギミックのアイデアやボリューム感もすごいのだが、このゲームを何より傑作たらしめているのはその「解きやすさ」にある。
まず第一にパズル１つ１つが非常にコンパクトで、プレイヤーに気付いてほしいアイデアのエッセンスのみをパズルに落とし込んでいる印象。それゆえに「難易度自体はそこまで高くないのに気付きの連続で楽しい」というプレイ感覚を味わえる。この点は[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1260520/Patricks_Parabox] Patrick's Parabox[/url]に近く、あちらを気に入っている方には特におすすめ。

またそれだけでなく、
・アイテムの新しい使い方などの知識が自動的にゲーム内で記録されていき、いつでも見返せる
・現時点の知識で今解いているパズルがクリア可能か教えてくれる
・今解いているパズルに必要な知識が（今知っているうちの）どれなのか教えてくれる
・全パズルに段階的なヒントが実装されており、プレイヤーの望んだ時点で見ることができる
・Undo、Reset完備
・一度解いたパズルは簡易移動可能（毎回解き直さなくてもよい）
など、とことん「解きやすさ」にこだわった作りになっているのも素晴らしい。

日本語は実装されていないが何となく動かしながら理解することもできるし、ゲーム内の英文も翻訳を随時活用すれば問題ないレベル。propelって推進するって意味なのか…だからプロペラって言うのか……と逆に英語に対する知識も付いたりした。

ゲームの質・量ともにかなり高水準、それなのに難しすぎず、解く楽しさ・気付く楽しさを存分に味わえる傑作。おすすめ（3度目）。

В какой-то момент разработчикам из Telltale Games, очевидно, надоело делать традиционные адвенчуры в духе «золотого века» квестов, только в 3D. И началась The Walking Dead, которая продержалась вот уже целый сезон, сорвав в конце бурные овации игроков, протирающих платочком глаза от нахлынувших чувств. Потому что, как ни крути, это оказалась игра, вполне сравнимая, например, с Heavy Rain по накалу страстей — а в чем-то, может быть, и превосходящая творение Quantic Dream. Делать продолжение триумфального проекта всегда вдвойне сложно. Потому что ожидания публики уже завышены, а порадовать игроков в первом эпизоде нового сезона такой же эпической драмой, как и в последней части предыдущего, — мягко говоря, непростая задача. Видимо, как раз для того, чтобы с разбегу выжать из глаз суровых геймеров скупую слезу, авторы сменили главного героя на главную героиню, сделав ее маленькой, беспомощной, хрупкой и, в общем, Клементиной, заботе о которой была во многом посвящена жизнь нашего прошлого протагониста — Ли. Буквально на этом самом месте мы должны предупредить, что дальше вас ожидает приличное количество спойлеров. Потому что писать без них об интерактивной истории вроде The Walking Dead просто невозможно. В конце прошлого сезона Клементина была сдана «с рук на руки» Кристе и Омиду — почти семейной паре. В самом начале All That Remains два воркующих голубка активно выбирают имя своему будущему первенцу — и это уже наводит на нехорошие мысли. Потому что мы-то с вами знаем, что подобные разговоры — плохой признак, который свидетельствует о тяжкой судьбе либо для самих родителей, либо для потенциального дитяти.Правило не подводит. Буквально через несколько минут игрового времени Клементина уже оказывается в компании не двух, а одного сопровождающего. Чтобы мы, так сказать, не расслаблялись и не откладывали свои носовые платки далеко. Этот сюжетный поворотец, конечно, выглядит немного притянутым за уши. Трагическая гибель одного из главных героев — не итог тяжелого морального выбора игрока и даже не результат нападения зомби. Речь идет всего только о случайности, о дурацкой случайности, о которой обычно говорят «глупая, нелепая смерть». Впрочем, быть может, создатели игры именно такого эффекта и хотели добиться? В чем Telltale нельзя отказать, так это в умении безукоризненно держать ритм повествования, чередуя этапы нагнетания напряжения с краткими периодами «отдыха» и экшен-сценами, интерактивность которых была и остается достаточно сомнительной. В любом случае, даже когда мы просто тихо ходим по лесу, ни на кого особенно не натыкаясь, скучно не становится. Все дело в гнетущей атмосфере и полной беспомощности Клементины — в какой-то момент девочка остается один на один с жестоким миром даже без привычного оружия за пазухой. На адвенчуру сериал походит все меньше и меньше. Так, ни разу за все время прохождения All That Remains нам не приходится напрягать извилины, чтобы выйти из какой-нибудь сложной ситуации. Здесь нет ни одной загадки — только поиск активных точек, по которым достаточно кликнуть, чтобы добиться желаемого результата сразу и без малейших усилий. Игра по-прежнему не про мыслительные процессы, а, скорее, про реакцию — во всех смыслах этого слова. На скорость психомоторных реакций в интерактивных сценах. На глубину эмоционального отклика — во всех остальных.
Этому самому эмоциональному отклику, безусловно, способствует прекрасная мимическая анимация. Совершенно взрослое, очень собранное, порой отчаянно упрямое выражение лица маленькой Клементины воздействует на наши чувства, право же, сильнее, чем все «сюжетные» инквизиторские ухищрения, призванные показать, как несчастный ребенок страдает. Начало второго сезона полностью соответствует ожиданиям игроков-реалистов. В All That Remains действительно случился некий спад напряженности событий по сравнению с финалом прошлогодней истории — спад совершенно неизбежный и предсказуемый. Но ритм сценаристы Telltale держат так же здорово, как и раньше, история цепляет так же сильно, как и раньше, наскучить все эти странствия живых между мертвыми явно не успели — в общем, все хорошо в The Walking Dead. В конце концов, если краткость эпизода по-прежнему воспринимается как главный его недостаток, значит, сериал очень крепко держится на плаву. Плюсы: динамичная история; харизматичная главная героиня; естественная мимика персонажей. Минусы: нарочитая и несколько бессмысленная жестокость некоторых сцен; притянутый за уши сюжетный ход в начале эпизода; иллюзорность выбора.
